sections.markdown:
## B — Audience, level and prerequisites: state laws of interest to drivers and golf cart rules
Audience: every South Carolina permit and license applicant, with the Selective Service item aimed at male applicants under twenty-six and the donor item at anyone applying or renewing.
Why it matters to a first-timer: the application itself asks about Selective Service and organ donation [A01], and the golf cart and littering rules are among the few traffic laws this manual states outright [A02].
Level: plain legal recall with a few exact thresholds (ages, a distance and a road speed limit); low conceptual load.
Prerequisites: the beginner's permit and license application steps from the first section.

corpus_stability.reason: The South Carolina Driver's Manual prints a single edition line (Revised 06/2024) on its front cover; its disclaimer says legislative and SCDMV policy changes may make some content out of date until the agency incorporates them, and a possibly newer unlinked upload exists on the issuer site (freshness debt in the run jams), so the corpus is treated as revised at most about once a year, bound to the registered snapshot.
